gameDescriptionHtml:
EA SPORTS FC 24 welcomes you to The World’s Game: the most true-to-football experience ever with HyperMotionV, PlayStyles optimised by Opta, and an enhanced Frostbite Engine.

Game Features

  • AUTHENTICITY – EA SPORTS FC 24 is the most authentic football experience ever with 19,000+ fully licensed players, 700 teams, 30 leagues, and 300+ global partners across The World’s Game.
  • HYPERMOTION V TECHNOLOGY – HyperMotionV captures the game as it’s truly played, using volumetric data from more than 180 professional men’s and women’s football matches to recreate authentic motion.
  • WOMEN’S FOOTBALL IN ULTIMATE TEAM – Welcome women’s football to Ultimate Team and build your dream XI from leagues and competitions across the world, now including the WSL, NWSL, DIF, UWCL, Frauen Bundesliga, and Liga F.
  • Play Styles – PlayStyles dimensionalize athletes, interpreting real-world player data from Opta and other sources to provide tangible gameplay boosts that help players perform more like their on-pitch selves.
  • FROSTBITE ENGINE – The revolutionized Frostbite Engine delivers The World’s Game in lifelike detail, bringing a new level of immersion to each match in the most visually authentic football experience ever.
  • MANAGER CAREER & PLAYER CAREER – Create and implement your own tactical vision with new modern management features in Manager Career or pave your own path to glory with new Player Agent features in Player Career.
  • VISUAL OPTIMISATION ON PC – EA SPORTS FC 24 is the most authentic football experience on PC with new graphic settings that unlock vivid and optimized visuals on PC.
  • CONTROLLER SUPPORT – Play EA SPORTS FC 24 your way on PC by using your PlayStation or Xbox controllers.
  • CROSS-PLAY – Play together with friends on different platforms in 1vl modes from Ultimate Team to Online Seasons. Plus, connect and compete with more friends than ever through cross-play in Clubs and VOLTA FOOTBALL.
